page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Ersi" (line 19) could be "Etsi"; "Joli" could be "Jesu"; "peccatis" (line 33) is hard to read, the scan looks like "speccatis"; "Difp:" and "cont:" are read as printed. Italic passages are judged from the scan and may not be exact. A faint gathering mark at the foot is not legible and is left out. Lines 2 to 33 are set without paragraph indents on this page, so the text is one paragraph continued from the previous page. The catchword "tur," belongs to the word "remittantur" on the next page. Shadowing from the neighbouring page is not transcribed.
